note: Modello's actions, keys and menus: G, R and S move, turn and scale the selection after the pointer (X, Y and Z lock an axis, Shift a plane, digits type the amount, Enter or a click confirms, Escape or a right click cancels); Shift+A adds, X and Delete delete, Shift+D duplicates, H hides; the numpad turns the view; Ctrl+Z undoes. Every change of the scene goes through an action that keeps an undo snapshot first.

computed.openedIsScene: {{type(state.opened) == 'object' ? state.opened.format == 'modello-scene' && type(state.opened.added) == 'number' && (type(state.opened.scene) == 'object' ? type(state.opened.scene.materials) == 'list' && (type(state.opened.scene.nodes) == 'list' ? length(state.opened.scene.nodes) <= 500 && every(state.opened.scene.nodes, (type(it) == 'object' ? type(it.id) == 'string' && type(it.name) == 'string' && (it.kind == 'mesh' || it.kind == 'light' || it.kind == 'camera') && (type(it.translation) == 'list' ? length(it.translation) == 3 && every(it.translation, type(it) == 'number') : false) && (type(it.rotationDegrees) == 'list' ? length(it.rotationDegrees) == 3 && every(it.rotationDegrees, type(it) == 'number') : false) && (type(it.scale) == 'list' ? length(it.scale) == 3 && every(it.scale, type(it) == 'number') : false) : false)) : false) : false) : false}}
computed.centre: {{ { x: nodes.viewport.x + nodes.viewport.width / 2 - 100, y: nodes.viewport.y + nodes.viewport.height / 2 - 60 } }}
computed.lastCentre: {{state.lastOp == null || length(state.lastOp.base) == 0 ? [0, 0, 0] : map([sum(map(state.lastOp.base, it.translation[0])), sum(map(state.lastOp.base, it.translation[1])), sum(map(state.lastOp.base, it.translation[2]))], it / length(state.lastOp.base))}}
computed.searchItems: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled && it.name != 'search'), { title: it.title, detail: it.keyLabel ?? it.category, icon: it.icon, run: it.name })}}
computed.cameraView: {{computed.cameraNode == null ? null : { target: [computed.cameraNode.translation[0] - sin(radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[0])) * sin(radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[2])) * 10, computed.cameraNode.translation[1] + sin(radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[0])) * cos(radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[2])) * 10, computed.cameraNode.translation[2] - cos(radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[0])) * 10], yaw: radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[2]), pitch: pi() / 2 - radians(computed.cameraNode.rotationDegrees[0]), distance: 10, fieldOfView: computed.cameraNode.camera.fieldOfView ?? 0.69, orthographic: false } }}

do.to: {{merge(state.tmp, { translation: map(m.translation, state.tmp.lock_translation[index] == true ? state.tmp.translation[index] : round(it * 10000) / 10000), rotationDegrees: map(m.rotationDegrees, state.tmp.lock_rotationDegrees[index] == true ? state.tmp.rotationDegrees[index] : round(it * 1000) / 1000), scale: map(m.scale, state.tmp.lock_scale[index] == true ? state.tmp.scale[index] : round(it * 10000) / 10000) })}}

transformed.to: {{ { title: event.mode == 'translate' ? 'Move' : event.mode == 'rotate' ? 'Rotate' : 'Resize', kind: event.mode, base: state.lastBase, values: event.mode == 'translate' ? map(event.nodes[0].translation, round((it - state.lastBase[0].translation[index]) * 10000) / 10000) : event.mode == 'scale' ? map(event.nodes[0].scale, state.lastBase[0].scale[index] == 0 ? 1 : round(it / state.lastBase[0].scale[index] * 10000) / 10000) : length(state.lastBase) == 1 ? map(event.nodes[0].rotationDegrees, round((it - state.lastBase[0].rotationDegrees[index]) * 100) / 100) : null } }}

do.to: {{merge(b, state.lastOp.kind == 'scale' ? { translation: map(b.translation, b.lock_translation[index] == true ? it : computed.lastCentre[index] + (it - computed.lastCentre[index]) * state.lastOp.values[index]), scale: map(b.scale, b.lock_scale[index] == true ? it : round(it * state.lastOp.values[index] * 10000) / 10000) } : state.lastOp.kind == 'rotate' ? { rotationDegrees: map(b.rotationDegrees, b.lock_rotationDegrees[index] == true ? it : round((it + state.lastOp.values[index]) * 100) / 100) } : { translation: map(b.translation, b.lock_translation[index] == true ? it : round((it + state.lastOp.values[index]) * 10000) / 10000) })}}

typeDigit.to: {{args.key == 'back' ? slice(state.modal.typed, 0, max(0, length(state.modal.typed) - 1)) : args.key == '-' ? (slice(state.modal.typed, 0, 1) == '-' ? slice(state.modal.typed, 1) : '-' + state.modal.typed) : state.modal.typed + args.key}}

addObject.to: {{ { title: 'Add ' + args.name, kind: 'translate', label: 'Location', base: [merge(state.scene.nodes[length(state.scene.nodes) - 1], { translation: [0, 0, 0] })], values: args.at ?? state.cursor } }}

do.to: {{map(state.scene.nodes, contains(state.view.selection, it.id) ? merge(it, { visible: false }) : it)}}
{{map(state.scene.nodes, contains(state.view.selection, it.id) ? it : merge(it, { visible: false }))}}

toggleLock.to: {{map(range(3), index == args.axis ? computed.activeNode['lock_' + args.key][index] != true : computed.activeNode['lock_' + args.key][index] == true)}}

swapEditor.to: {{ { from: find(keys(state.areas), state.areas[it] == args.from), to: find(keys(state.areas), state.areas[it] == args.to) } }}

then.to: {{[state.view.camera.target[0] - (cos(state.view.camera.yaw) * args.dx) * state.view.camera.distance * 0.002, state.view.camera.target[1] + (sin(state.view.camera.yaw) * args.dx) * state.view.camera.distance * 0.002, state.view.camera.target[2] + args.dy * state.view.camera.distance * 0.002]}}

{{sort(concat(filter(state.scene.nodes[state.tmp].keyframes ?? [], it.frame != state.frame), [{ frame: state.frame, translation: state.scene.nodes[state.tmp].translation, rotationDegrees: state.scene.nodes[state.tmp].rotationDegrees, scale: state.scene.nodes[state.tmp].scale }]), 'frame')}}

do.to: {{map(state.scene.nodes, contains(state.view.selection, it.id) && it.keyframes != null ? merge(it, { keyframes: filter(it.keyframes, it.frame != state.frame) }) : it)}}
{{map(state.scene.nodes, contains(state.view.selection, it.id) && it.keyframes != null ? merge(it, { keyframes: [] }) : it)}}

moveKeyframe.to: {{map(state.scene.nodes, contains(state.view.selection, it.id) && it.keyframes != null ? merge(it, { keyframes: sort(map(it.keyframes, it.frame == state.tmp.from ? merge(it, { frame: state.tmp.to }) : it), 'frame') }) : it)}}

do.to: {{ { at: indexOf(map(state.scene.nodes, it.id), n.id), a: find(reverse(n.keyframes), it.frame <= state.frame) ?? n.keyframes[0], b: find(n.keyframes, it.frame >= state.frame) ?? n.keyframes[length(n.keyframes) - 1] } }}

{{merge(n, { translation: map(state.pose.a.translation, round((it + (state.pose.b.translation[index] - it) * state.pose.u) * 10000) / 10000), rotationDegrees: map(state.pose.a.rotationDegrees, round((it + (state.pose.b.rotationDegrees[index] - it) * state.pose.u) * 1000) / 1000), scale: map(state.pose.a.scale, round((it + (state.pose.b.scale[index] - it) * state.pose.u) * 10000) / 10000) })}}

tick.to: {{state.playing == 'reverse' ? (state.frame <= computed.range[0] ? computed.range[1] : state.frame - 1) : (state.frame >= computed.range[1] ? computed.range[0] : state.frame + 1)}}

do.to: {{[round(sum(state.tmp, it.translation[0]) / length(state.tmp) * 10000) / 10000, round(sum(state.tmp, it.translation[1]) / length(state.tmp) * 10000) / 10000, round(sum(state.tmp, it.translation[2]) / length(state.tmp) * 10000) / 10000]}}

do.saveFile: {{ { format: 'modello-scene', version: 1, scene: state.scene, added: state.added } }}
do.name: scene.json
do.title: Save the scene

else.to: {{'Not opened: ' + (state.openedName ?? 'the file') + ' is not a Modello scene'}}
